parameters.query: WITH prior AS(SELECT quote_key,COALESCE(MAX(version),0)+1 next_version FROM quotes WHERE quote_key=$1 GROUP BY quote_key FOR UPDATE),q AS(INSERT INTO quotes(quote_key,customer_id,currency,version,status,subtotal_minor,discount_minor,tax_minor,total_minor,valid_until,requested_by)SELECT quote_key,$2,$3,next_version,CASE WHEN $10 THEN'pending_approval'ELSE'approved'END,$4,$5,$6,$7,now()+make_interval(days=>$8),$9 FROM prior RETURNING id,quote_key,version),l AS(INSERT INTO quote_lines(quote_id,sku,description,quantity,unit_price_minor,tax_rate_bps)SELECT q.id,x.sku,x.description,x.quantity,x.unit_price_minor,x.tax_rate_bps FROM q,jsonb_to_recordset($11::jsonb)x(sku text,description text,quantity int,unit_price_minor bigint,tax_rate_bps int)),a AS(INSERT INTO approvals(quote_id,quote_version,role,status)SELECT q.id,q.version,role,'pending'FROM q,unnest($12::text[])role),u AS(UPDATE quotes SET status='void',updated_at=now()WHERE quote_key=$1 AND id<>(SELECT id FROM q)AND status IN('draft','pending_approval','approved','sent')RETURNING id)INSERT INTO audit_log(entity_type,entity_id,actor,action,details)SELECT'quote',id,$13,'quote_revised',jsonb_build_object('quote_key',quote_key,'version',version)FROM q RETURNING entity_id;
